from fieldwork on the Qinghai–Tibetan Plateau to global-scale analyses of tropical
plants.

## Research interests

Macroevolution, macroecology and conservation; diversity patterns and their
responses to climate change; phylogenetic and functional diversity; the
biogeography of mountains and tropical rainforests; reproducible large-scale
biodiversity analysis.

## Bibliometrics

Publications in *Science*, *PNAS*, *Current Biology*, *National Science Review*,
*Proceedings of the Royal Society B*, *Conservation Biology* and *Biological
Conservation*, including one **ESI Highly Cited Paper** (Web of Science).
See the [Publications](publications.qmd) page.
